MEET YOUR INSTRUCTOR

Christopher Rigell

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Instructor

Christopher Rigell began his Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu journey in 2018 under the guidance of Rocian Gracie Junior. He currently holds the rank of third-degree purple belt and continues to develop his skills through dedicated training, competition, and teaching.

With nearly three years of experience coaching children’s Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and approximately a year and a half teaching adult classes, Christopher is passionate about helping students of all ages develop their technical abilities, confidence, discipline, and respect for martial arts.

MEET YOUR INSTRUCTOR

Alejandra Padilla

Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Instructor | Child Psychologist

Alejandra Padilla has been training in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu since 2024 and currently holds the rank of third-degree blue belt at Rocian Gracie Junior Tijuana. With over two years of experience coaching children’s Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, she is passionate about helping young students develop their skills, confidence, discipline, and respect through martial arts.

As a child psychologist, Alejandra brings a valuable understanding of children’s emotional, social, and developmental needs to her coaching. Her background allows her to approach teaching with an emphasis on positive reinforcement, patience, and age-appropriate instruction, creating a supportive environment where children can learn, overcome challenges, and grow both on and off the mats.

In addition to her Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu training, Alejandra practices Judo at Kino Judo Club under the guidance of Sensei Hector Figueroa. Her continued involvement in martial arts reflects her commitment to personal growth, technical development, and lifelong learning.

Alejandra believes that Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu offers children much more than physical skills. Through consistent training, students can develop perseverance, self-confidence, problem-solving abilities, and respect for others—qualities that benefit them far beyond the academy.

Combining her martial arts experience with her professional background in child psychology, Alejandra is dedicated to providing a positive and enriching learning experience for every child she coaches, helping each student progress at their own pace while building a strong foundation for the future.
